모든 대회·선수·기록·설정과 업로드 파일을 ZIP 하나로 내려받고, 그: Downloads all competitions, athletes, results, settings and uploaded files as a single ZIP, and restores the whole system from that file. Daily and hourly automatic backups are kept separately in the server's backups/ folder.
복원하면 현재 데이터가 백업 파일 내용으로 바뀝니다. 복원 직전 상태는: Restoring replaces the current data with the contents of the backup file. The state just before the restore is saved automatically as a safety backup; after the restore the server restarts and the page reloads in about 10 seconds.
이 서버는 PostgreSQL 을 씁니다. 데이터베이스 전체 백업은 클라: This server uses PostgreSQL. Full database backups are handled by cloud (RDS) automatic backups and the server's daily pg_backup (stored in S3); restores are done by the server administrator. For per-competition files, use the per-competition backup above.
